name: ingest_sources
description: Create or refresh the index for a local path (code, docs, or both). Use `incremental=true` (default) to amortize re-ingest after edits; pass `domains` to scope to one side. Returns a `source_id` that every other tool requires. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

domains.description: Which index to build. `auto` ingests whichever the path contains.

incremental.description: Reuse the existing index and reprocess only changed files.

name: catalog_sources
description: List indexed sources with their capabilities, language counts, and freshness. Code and docs for the same workspace share one `source_id` and appear as separate entries distinguished by `domain`. Pair the returned `source_id` with `domain` on downstream calls; pass `cursor` to page when many sources are registered. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a prior call.

name: search_catalog
description: Unified ranked search over symbols, doc sections, and raw file text — preferred over native Grep for any code or docs lookup. `query_mode=keyword` is the fastest path for identifiers; `regex` auto-routes to file-text scanning (and ignores `unit_kinds`); `natural_language` enables dense retrieval and answers questions. Narrow with `unit_kinds` (`symbol`, `section`, `file`, or alias `doc_section` to opt into doc-only search), `scope` / `exclude` / `file_pattern`, and budget with `max_tokens`. With `fuzzy=true` the response carries two lanes — an exact BM25 lane and a parallel nucleo-matcher lane ranked by subsequence score with a kind-priority tie-break (types > callables > constants > re-exports) — so typos still surface candidates without polluting the exact ranking. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

query.description: Search text. With `query_mode=regex`, may also be passed as `pattern`.

domain.description: Defaults to `code` for keyword/regex and `hybrid` for natural_language. Pass explicitly to override.

unit_kinds.description: Limit hits to `symbol`, `section`, and/or `file`. Alias `doc_section` resolves to `section` and is the recommended way to scope a search to docs only. Ignored under `query_mode=regex`.

scope.description: Repo-relative prefix or substring inclusion filter.

exclude.description: Repo-relative prefixes or substrings to skip. Complements `scope`.

offset.description: Skip the first N ranked hits before applying limit (pagination).

query_mode.description: `keyword` (default-ish): exact / BM25 over identifiers. `regex`: file-text scan (`unit_kinds` ignored). `natural_language`: dense retrieval, implies `semantic=true`.

context_lines.description: Lines of before/after context for file-text hits, and for symbol/section hits when `include_body=true`. Default 0.

include_body.description: Include the full source span (symbols) or section text (sections). Default false.

max_tokens.description: Soft cap on serialized item bytes (~4 bytes/token). Alias: `token_budget`.

fuzzy.description: Add a nucleo-matcher fuzzy lane over symbol names alongside the exact lane (code domain only). Default false.

repo_path.description: Override the resolved repo root for this call.

semantic.description: Augment retrieval with dense embeddings. Implied by `query_mode=natural_language`. Falls back to lexical with a `SEMANTIC_FALLBACK` warning when embeddings are unavailable.

pattern.description: Alias for `query` when `query_mode=regex`. Mutually exclusive with `query`.

include_vendored.description: Include matches under vendored / asset / fixture paths and oversized JSON dumps. Default false (such hits are pushed to the tail with a heavy score penalty). A `scope=` targeting an excluded segment also opts in.

name: read_content
description: Batch-read symbols, doc sections, or bounded file ranges in one call (always prefer this to N reads). Each `refs` entry can be an object or a shorthand string: `"path:N-M"` (range), `"path:N"` (single line), `"path::Name#kind"` (symbol). Whole-file reads work but are a last resort — call `inspect_structure view=file_outline` first; oversized reads emit `TOKEN_HEAVY_READ` and outline-first hints. Set `max_tokens` to bound the payload (later refs stub out with `truncated: true`); set `wait_for_fresh=true` when a reindex is mid-flight. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

refs.description: List of refs to read. Each entry resolves to a symbol, section, or file range.

stable_id.description: Stable id of the symbol or section.

symbol_name.description: Bare symbol name. Combine with `path` (preferred) or pass alone for a globally unique name.

context_lines.description: Lines of before/after context per ref.

max_tokens.description: Soft token budget for the combined payload (~4 bytes/token). Later refs stub with `{truncated: true, reason: 'token_budget_exceeded'}`. Alias: `token_budget`.

wait_for_fresh.description: If a reindex is mid-flight for this `source_id`, block until it completes or `max_wait_ms` elapses.

name: inspect_structure
description: File trees, file outlines, repo rollups, table-of-contents views, and class hierarchies — use this instead of native Glob, `ls -R`, or reading whole files just to see their shape. Pick `view=file_outline` (or `file_paths` for a batch) before any whole-file read; `view=file_tree` for project structure (`max_files` truncates); `view=repo_outline` / `repository_rollup` for a workspace-level summary; `view=toc` / `toc_tree` / `document_outline` for docs. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

class_path.description: `class_hierarchy`: required — class name to root the hierarchy on.

max_tokens.description: Token budget (~4 bytes/token) applied to `file_tree` and `repo_outline`.

name: inspect_graph
description: Reference, import, and dependency-graph queries with cross-file resolution — preferred over manual Grep walks. Pick `graph`: `imports` / `importers` for file-to-file edges (importers union explicit `use`-statement edges with symbol-usage edges, so a Rust `mod x; x::Y` access counts even when no `use` exists); `references` / `find_references` (split into `semantic_references` + `candidate_text_hits`) for symbol usages; `calls` (tagged `edge_kind: direct|indirect`) for the call graph; `dependencies` / `dependency_cycles` / `module_coupling` / `layer_violations` / `centrality` for module-level analysis; `resolve_fqn` for fully-qualified-name lookup. Narrow with `scope`, `exclude`, `file_pattern`. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

symbol_id.description: `calls`: required — stable id of the symbol whose call sites to enumerate.

file_path.description: `imports` / `importers`: required — file path whose outgoing or incoming edges to enumerate.

include_call_chain.description: `find_references`: include calling-symbol chain on each hit.

cross_repo.description: `dependencies` / `importers`: include cross-repo package edges. Default false.

max_tokens.description: `dependencies`: token budget (~4 bytes/token) for edges/nodes. Alias `token_budget`.

scope.description: Path-prefix / substring inclusion filter. Applies to imports, importers, find_references, references, related, calls.

file_pattern.description: Glob pattern (e.g. `crates/foo/**/*.rs`) filtering edge endpoints by file path.

include_vendored.description: `find_references`: include hits under vendored / asset / fixture paths. Default false. A `scope=` targeting an excluded segment also opts in.

name: evaluate_impact
description: Change-oriented analysis: `blast_radius`, `rename_safety`, `path_rename` (Rust `use`-prefix rewrites; `apply=true` writes to disk), `diff` (two symbol refs in the same file), `changed_units` / `change_velocity` (commit-anchored). `rename_safety` resolves refs strictly (NOT_FOUND on unresolved structured refs), is trait-dispatch-aware, requires a receiver-shape prefix at call sites for method-like symbols (so `obj.foo(` and `Type::foo(` count but a bare `foo` does not), reports the count of `excluded_vendored_or_fixture` hits skipped by the scan, and emits a `confidence` field on the reference scan (`high` / `partial` / `none_after_filters`). Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic` (separate from the scan-local `reference_scan.confidence`).

refs.description: blast_radius/impact_preview/rename_safety: required, at least refs[0] as a symbol ref. rename_safety additionally requires `new_name` on refs[0]. diff: exactly two symbol refs in the same file. changed_units: one or two commit refs ({kind: 'commit', id: '<sha>'}); one compares against HEAD.

kind.description: `symbol` for symbol refs, `commit` for commit refs.

id.description: Symbol stable id, or commit sha for commit refs.

symbol_name.description: Bare symbol name. Combine with `path` (preferred) or pass alone for a globally unique name.

new_name.description: rename_safety only: the proposed new symbol name.

from.description: `path_rename`: fully-qualified Rust path prefix to rewrite.

apply.description: `path_rename`: when true, write edits to disk and reindex. Default false (dry-run).

scope.description: `path_rename`: optional file or directory prefix to limit candidates.

handle_partial_group_imports.description: `path_rename`: how to handle grouped imports that only partially match the old prefix.

include_vendored.description: `rename_safety` / `blast_radius`: include scans / importers under vendored / asset / fixture paths. Default false. A `scope=` targeting an excluded segment also opts in.

limit.description: `blast_radius`: cap on per-bucket importer list (default 25). `direct_importers_total` / `transitive_importers_total` always carry the un-truncated counts.

max_tokens.description: `blast_radius`: soft byte budget (~4 bytes/token). When the serialized importer lists exceed this, both buckets are packed and `truncated_by` is set in `_meta`.

name: evaluate_quality
description: Quality metrics: `complexity`, `repo_health`, `dead_code`, `hotspots`, `doc_coverage`, `broken_links`, `refactor_targets`, `quality_signal` (4 agent-readiness dimensions plus structural root causes; pass `scope` for a slice), `regression_check` (compare against a snapshot), `test_gaps`. `dead_code` walks reachability over the import graph plus structural edges and applies a string-literal dispatch heuristic — a symbol whose name appears as a string literal in two or more other files is promoted to a live root (likely router / handler-table dispatch); single-file mentions stay weak signals. By default both `dead_files` and `dead_symbols` exclude test code: test files (`*_test.go`, `tests/`, `test_*.py`, …) and inline test functions (Rust `mod tests`, `#[test]`, Python `def test_…`, Go `TestXxx`) are entry-only — the harness invokes them, not other indexed code, so a `no_structural_inbound` verdict is meaningless. Pass `include_tests=true` to inspect test code on its own merits. Tune further with `granularity`, `min_confidence`, `entry_point_patterns`, `include_vendored`, and `paranoid` (drops the confidence floor to 0.0, forces a symbol-level pass, and emits `heuristic_disagreements`). With `_meta_verbose=true`, `_meta.thresholds` echoes defaults from `crates/codesight-analysis/src/thresholds.rs`. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

refs.description: `complexity`: required symbol ref. `doc_coverage`: required list of symbol refs (capped at 200).

include_tests.description: `dead_code`: include test files and inline test functions (Rust `mod tests`, `#[test]`, Python `def test_…`, Go `TestXxx`) in `dead_files` and `dead_symbols`. Default false — test code is entry-only and meaningless under reachability.

entry_point_patterns.description: `dead_code`: extra entry-point file-name patterns to treat as live roots.

top_n.description: `hotspots` / `dead_code` / `refactor_targets`: cap the returned list (default 50 for hotspots/refactor_targets, 25 for dead_code).

top_files.description: `refactor_targets` (repo mode, when `file_path` is omitted): number of hottest files to scan. Default 10.

top_caller_files.description: `refactor_targets`: max `caller_files` entries per candidate (clamped 1..=50). When truncated, `caller_files_total` carries the full count.

include_conventional.description: `hotspots` / `refactor_targets`: include scripts/, tests/, examples/, benches/, build.rs, fixtures/, testdata/, stress/. Off by default — codegen helpers and fixtures otherwise dominate the ranking.

file_path.description: `refactor_targets`: file to scope the scan to. Omit for repo-wide mode over the hottest `top_files`.

max_tokens.description: `dead_code`: serialized-response token budget (~4 bytes/token). Trims `dead_files`/`dead_symbols` until the response fits. Alias: `token_budget`.

scope.description: `quality_signal`: optional file or directory prefix to score instead of the whole repo.

include_vendored.description: `dead_code`: include files under vendored / asset / fixture paths. Default false. A `scope=` targeting an excluded segment also opts in.

paranoid.description: `dead_code`: drop the confidence floor to 0.0 (surfacing `weak_string_dispatch_match` / `test_only_alive`), always run the symbol-level pass, and emit `heuristic_disagreements` listing files the legacy import-graph reachability would have flagged dead but the current string-literal-dispatch heuristic rescued.

name: assemble_context
description: Bundle search+read into one packed payload, expand a doc section with neighbors, or get ranked / suggestion lists. Pick `mode`: `context_bundle` (one symbol ref + `depth` knob, default 2 — pulls in type refs and a representative caller/callee, renders imports in language-native form, honors `include_tests`); `section_context` (one section ref + child headings); `ranked` / `query_suggestions` (opening-move shortlist for a `query`); `rename_plan` (collision pre-check). All modes report honest full-file baseline `tokens_saved` and respect `max_tokens` / `token_budget`. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

query.description: Search text for `ranked` / `query_suggestions`; falls back as `old_name` for `rename_plan`.

refs.description: `section_context`: required — one section ref. `context_bundle`: required — one symbol ref. Same shape as `read_content` refs.

budget_strategy.description: `context_bundle`: `compact` (strip sources) or `most_relevant` (ordering label; packing uses token budget when set).

include_kinds.description: `ranked`: filter symbol hits to these kinds (e.g. `class`).

old_name.description: `rename_plan`: existing symbol name. Falls back to `query` when unset.

new_name.description: `rename_plan`: proposed new name used for collision checks.

name: manage_indexes
description: Index lifecycle and session bookkeeping: `invalidate`, `delete`, `rebuild` (requires `root_hint`), `status`, `snapshot_quality`, `session_stats`, `session_end`, `analysis_health`. Most actions target a single source and require `source_id`; `session_stats` is global and does not. `session_end` captures the closing quality snapshot, closes the session ledger, and returns the same rollup as `session_stats` plus `quality_delta` warnings on regression. `analysis_health` surfaces graph / reachability / staleness counters — `unresolved_use_statements > 0` and zero `workspace_crate_edges` in a multi-crate repo are red flags. Returns `_meta.confidence: safe|partial|heuristic`.

source_id.description: Required for invalidate/delete/rebuild/status/snapshot_quality; ignored for session_stats/session_end unless needed for snapshot capture.

snapshot_name.description: `snapshot_quality`: logical name for the snapshot (default `session`). Overwrites existing.
